parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that the source "path" is derived from a line read by fgets(). The code removes the terminating newline character (lines 42‑46). Since fgets() stops reading at the first newline, the resulting string cannot contain any embedded newline or CRLF sequence; it may contain a trailing carriage‑return if the file uses CRLF line endings, but this cannot produce an HTTP header injection. Therefore the trigger of inserting \r\n is infeasible with the current input handling, and the reported HTTP response splitting vulnerability cannot be exercised.
